packs.notes: The one small phrase shipped so the pack seam is real end-to-end. The file is base64 TEXT: the repo's write path cannot carry binaries (the Trauma GLB transport), so the phrase rides encoded — its decoded bytes are the original 105-byte humming-line.mid, bit-identical (sha256 above, of the decoded bytes). Terrell's own packs drop into this folder with one INDEX line each — a raw .mid, or a .b64 with an "encoding": "base64" line; the brain quotes a pack's contour and varies it — packs never play themselves.
packs.title: Humming Line — bundled test phrase (8 notes, 100 bpm)
